title: Quote a run name
prompt: Implement describe so describe 'Icebow trial' 20 prints run=Icebow trial seeds=20.

title: Affordability branch
prompt: Print play for elixir at least 6, otherwise wait. Example: affordable 5 prints wait.

title: Seed labels
prompt: Loop over 0 1 2; print seed=0 then seed=1 then seed=2, one per line.
hint: End a for loop with done.
solution: for seed in 0 1 2; do printf 'seed=%s\n' "$seed"; done

title: Capture failure
prompt: Return status 7 from worker, capture it, then print status=7. Do not exit the whole script with 7.
starter:
# TODO: fix the return status
worker() { return 0; }
worker
status=$?
printf 'status=%s\n' "$status"

title: Wait for output
prompt: Launch worker in the background, save its PID, wait, then print collected. Expected lines: worker and collected.
starter:
worker() { printf 'worker\n'; }
# TODO: launch, capture PID, wait, print
hint: Use $! for the last background PID.
solution:
worker() { printf 'worker\n'; }
worker &
child=$!
wait "$child"
printf 'collected\n'
